description: This card appears to be defective because it's blank! The manufacturer may have forgotten to put in it's stats or it may be someone's cruel joke. Bring this to the Kafra Staff in the Kafra Headquarters in Aldebaran. _

name: Slotting Advertisement
description: Come visit us in Payon as we amaze you with our Brand new service of adding a Card slot to normal equipment! You've never seen something so amazing; Watch as Troy adds a slot with his eyes closed, it is an adventure for the whole family! _ This old advertisement is from many years ago, but it does promise the best of service from the best item Socket expert the world has ever known. The map on the 2nd page of the flyer looks like the shop would be north of the grain mill in Payon. _

name: Knight Of Honor
description: A coin which symbolizing the spirit of the pegasus knight are engraved. _

name: Thorn Plant Seed
description: A seed covered in thorns that would be painful to touch or step on. Used for genetic skill ''Thorn Trap'', ''Thorn Wall'', and ''Crazy Weed''. _

name: Blood Sucker Plant Seed
description: A disgusting looking seed that emits a red light and appears to be filled with blood like liquid. Used for genetic skill ''Blood Sucker''. _

name: Bomb Mushroom Spore
description: A purple spore. It can emit purple toxic dust so you have to be careful when handling. Used for genetic skill ''Spore Explosion''. _

name: Explosive Powder
description: A black powder that explodes at high temperatures. It seems stronger than gunpowder. _

name: Smoke Powder
description: A white powder. It's extremely light and scatters quickly in the air, and is said to be harmless. _

name: Tear Gas
description: A gas to intense eye and nose irritation. _

name: Oil Bottle
description: A bottle containing a large quantity of oil. It's definately not edible. _

name: Mandragora Flowerpot
description: A mandragora flowerpot used in experimentation. Extremely fragile. Definately do not remove it. _

name: Dieshin's Delivery Box
description: Character Bound. A delivery box from Dieshin Man in the Eden Group. _

name: Mysterious Dyestuffs
description: Various colors are mixed into this mysterious dye mixture. Can be used to dye a Beanie, Drooping Cat, Mage Hat, or Deviruchi Hat to a different color. _

name: Mystic Leaf Cat Ball
description: A ball with mysterious power. _

name: Shining Beads
description: A pure small bead. _

name: Carnium
description: [SQI Ingredient] One of the hardest metals on the Rune Midgard continent. It has a extraordinary degree of strength but it's too solid to be easily refined. _

name: Bradium
description: [SQI Ingredient] The strongest mineral found in the Ash Vacuum. It seems very difficult to work with, but with research its come to be the best ore for forging weapons. _

name: HD Carnium
description: An ancient piece of high density kalunium. This could be used to produce incredible armor. _

name: HD Bradium
description: An incredible valuable ore studied by midgard's scholars. It is the best for armor refining. _

name: Guarana Fruit
description: A famous desert fruit. It's commonly used on hot days in icecream or juice. _

name: HD Oridecon
description: High Density Oridecon that has been buried deep underground. Usable for refining +7 and higher weapons (up to + 10). If the item fails to upgrade, the item is not lost, but instead loses 1 upgrade level. _

name: HD Elunium
description: High Density Elunium that has been buried deep underground. Usable for refining +7 and higher armor (up to + 10). If the item fails to upgrade, the item is not lost, but instead loses 1 upgrade level. _

name: Gun Powder
description: A dangerous ingredient that glows with a dark light. It's an explosive ingredient so handle with care. _

name: Black Powder
description: A beautiful pitch black powder for various uses. Be careful not to get it in your eyes. _

name: Yellow Powder
description: A flavorless and odorless yellow powder. It burns with an amazing blue flame. _

name: White Powder
description: A salt-like white powder with no odor. _

name: Melange Pot
description: A large pot for mixing various foods. _

name: Savage Meat
description: The finest cut of Savage meat. _

name: Cooking Skewer
description: A long skewer for cooking full roast. _

name: Black Charcoal
description: Black coal used as fuel. Adds flavor to food that you cook with it. _

name: Blood Of Wolf
description: Blood from a desert wolf for medicinal purposes. _

name: Cold Ice
description: An incredibly cold block of ice. _

name: Beef Head
description: A tough piece of meat that is usually boiled or pressed to make more tender. _

name: Large Cookpot
description: A light but large pan for mixing various ingredients. _

name: Ice Piece
description: Ice that has been crushed into a fine powder. _

name: Ice Crystal
description: [SQI Ingredient] A transparent ice crystal. _

name: Comodo Tropical Fruit
description: A famous tropical fruit commonly seen in Comodo. It looks like it would be sweet. _

name: Drosera Tentacle
description: A stiff tentacle taken from a Drosera from the Arunafeltz region. _

name: Petite's Tail
description: A tail section of a petite. _

name: Fine Noodles
description: Thin white noodles. Popular in the summer. _

name: Cool Gravy
description: A basic ingredient for cooking stew and some soups. _

name: Coconut Fruit
description: A tropical fruit with white juice. _

name: Melon
description: A light green round fruit that has a sweet fragrance. _

name: Pineapple
description: A fresh fruit that has a sort of sour and sweet flavor. Be careful cause the outside of the pineapple has sharp thorns. _

name: Apple Bomb Guidebook
description: A guide on how to make apple bombs. Ingredients : Apple, Scell, Dark Powder, Detonator _

name: Pineapple Bomb Guidebook
description: A guide on how to make pineapple bombs. Ingredients : Pineapple, Cactus Needle, 3 Dark Powder, Detonator _

name: How To Make A Coconut Fruit Bomb
description: A guide on how to make Coconut bombs. Ingredients : Coconut, 2 Dark Powder, Detonator _

name: Melon Bomb Guidebook
description: A guide on how to make Melon bombs. Ingredients : Melon, Sticky Mucus, 2 Dark Powder, Detonator _

name: Banana Bomb Guidebook
description: A guide on how to make banana bombs. Ingredients : Banana, Mold Powder, 4 Dark Powder, Detonator _

name: How to Grow Plant Genes
description: A guide book required for the cultivation of Thorny Seeds, Blood Sucker Seeds, and Explosive Mushroom Spores. Thorny Seed : 10 Thorny Fruit Blood Sucker : 10 Man Eater Root Explosive Mushroom Spore : 10 Mushroom Spore, 5 Poison Mushroom Spore, 2 Black Powder _

name: How to Make High Quality Potions
description: A guide on how to create Concentrated White Potion Z, Vitata500, and Concentrated Ceromain Soup. Concentrated White Potion : 10 Test Tubes, 5 White Potions Vitata500 : 10 Test Tubes, 10 White Potions Concentrated Ceromain Soup : 10 Test Tubes, 15 White Potions _

name: Crushed Pumpkin
description: A pumpmkin crushed. Somebody might drop it by mistake. _

name: Worn Cloth Piece
description: A cloth worn out. It seems to have been a transparent and clean cloth. _

name: Proof Of Sapha's Honor
description: This item cannot be traded with others. A certificate given by Sapha leaders for meritorious deeds.

name: Frozen Piece Of Skin
description: This item cannot be traded with others. A piece of skin that is frozen solid. Something is very strange about it...

name: Hard Bloodstain
description: This item cannot be traded with others. A mass made of somebody or something's blood. It is not similar to any human or creature's blood that you've ever seen before.

name: Cursed Magical Stone
description: This item cannot be traded with others. Mineral with an odd pulse similar to the dimensional crack. You sense a magic that is not of this world from it.

name: Unidentified Relic
description: This item cannot be traded with others. An unappraised ancient item. It's true nature is unknown.

name: Small Bradium
description: [SQI Ingredient] A shard from a broken piece of Bradium.

name: Premium Reset Stone
description: There's a rumor that when you find and see the man who knows about this stone, he would reset your status. _

name: Rake Helm
description: A sturdy helm with hooked horns. Can be sold to Item Collectors. _

name: Antler Helm
description: A slim helm with stag horns. Can be sold to Item Collectors. _

name: Two-Horn helm
description: A helm with small horns on both sides. Can be sold to Item Collectors. _

name: One-Horn Helm
description: A helm decorated with a single horn. Can be sold to Item Collectors. _

name: White Spider Legs
description: White leg of a Manuk region spider. Can be sold to Item Collectors. _

name: Queen Scaraba Shell
description: [SQI Ingredient] A beautiful wing fragment of a large insect. Gorgeous colors are displayed between the torn hide. _

name: Bulk Buyer Shop License
description: An official license from the Merchant Guild that allows you to open a Bulk Buyer Vending Shop. You must have at least 1 of the items in your inventory that you wish to Buy in Bulk from others. Consumed when using the Buying Store.

name: Mora Coin
description: A small coin with a polished surface. It is used for many purposes in the Village of Mora. _

name: Lope's Clue
description: A piece of paper with a few words written on it. When you put all of them together, you may be able to find out Lope's whereabouts. _

name: Lope's Ring
description: A wedding ring, a symbol of Lope's love for Euridi. _

name: Research Tool Bag
description: A bag that contains all the research tools used by researchers. _

name: Bath Water Sample
description: A sample of bath water, taken to study the mysterious power of the bath water. _

name: Teeth Sample
description: A tooth sample thought to be from the unidentified creature in the mysterious bath in Mora Village. _

name: Scale Sample
description: A scale sample thought to be from the unidentified creature in the mysterious bath in Mora Village. _

name: Sample of Puddle Research
description: A sample of puddle water, taken to study the bath in Mora Village. _

name: Small Pocket
description: A small pocket dropped by a Rapine. It contains something. _

name: Splendid Supply Kit
description: A box containing all kinds of commodities and food. Feels quite heavy. _

name: Bradium Box
description: A box full of Bradium mined in Manuk. It is made to look plain so that one can't tell what's inside by looking at it. _

name: Round Feather
description: [SQI Ingredient] A soft, light, and round feather. It seems useful for decorating things. _

name: Golden Feather
description: A sparkly and luxurious fur ball. It seems useful for decorating things. _

name: Angel Magic Powder
description: [SQI Ingredient] Mysterious powder, rumored to be used by naughty fairies to play tricks. Carries a hint of magical power. _

name: Palm Oil
description: Vegetable oil made out of coconuts. It is very heavy!

name: Coconut Oil
description: Coconut seeds. Used to make vegetable oil.

name: Comodo Leather
description: Leather of a Commodo. Used to make leather armors and weapons.

name: Kris Hilt
description: Hilt of a weapon.

name: Cendrawasih Feather
description: Tail feather of a bird named Cendrawasih. Its color is a strong and brilliant green.

name: Shining Cendrawasih Feather
description: Feathers used on the first Jati crown, it produces a beautiful light.

name: Silvervine Fruit
description: Sunkissed Silvervine Fruit. Humans think that it is normal and tastes bad but it is valuable in Malangdo. Use these as currency to exchange for access to memorial dungeons and to exchange for enchanting A-E grade coins with the Special Vending Machine and Coin Exchanger in Malangdo.

name: A Class Coin
description: Glittering high class coin. Used for enchanting luxurious level 4 weapons.

name: B Class Coin
description: Glittering high class coin. Used for enchanting luxurious level 4 weapons.

name: C Class Coin
description: General normal coin. Used for enchanting middle class weapons.

name: D Class Coin
description: General normal coin. Used for enchanting middle class weapons.

name: E Class Coin
description: Poor low class coin. A high number of these can be used to to enhance weapons.

name: Seagod's Anger
description: Relic of Seagod's anger. Nobody knows about the ability of this weapon.

name: Poor Can
description: It looks like normal canned food but the surface is rusted here and there. It actually grosses you out.

name: Poor Can Sack
description: Sack full of poor quality canned food. It's actual purpose is suspicious...

name: Adventure Card A
description: Adventure Card from Meow Adventure Club. This card is necessary for experiencing the adventure of the Meow Adventure Club.

name: Adventure Card B
description: Adventure Card from Meow Adventure Club. This card is necessary for experiencing the adventure of the Meow Adventure Club.

name: Fragment of Picture
description: A fragment of a picture which was found in the treasure hunt. When all the fragments are gathered, it will become a complete picture.

name: Bucket
description: A normal, ordinary bucket. Seems like anything can be carried with it.

name: All Filled Bucket
description: A bucket with water filled to the top. It is pretty heavy, so be careful not to spill it.

name: Cleaning Brush
description: A brush which is proper for cleaning. The bristles are abrasive enough so they will let a fine, well cleaning.

name: Fixing Kit
description: A Fixing Kit box for a crack in the ground. There is everything for fixing like shovel, saw, adhesives, stapler, sea cucumber and sea squirt.

name: Fresh Fruit
description: A freshly picked fruit of Yggdrasil. Smells fresh too!

name: Seagod's Protection
description: Rental Item A token in which Protection of the Seagod was endowed into. It allows you to have a special ability to survive deep under the sea. Used to access the Culvert Memorial Dungeon

name: Scaraba Perfume
description: A perfume made from Scaraba secreted material with odd smell. Feels like all the scarabas are looking at me.

name: Octopus Hunting Stick
description: Rental Item A special hunting stick to hunt Giant Octopus. Use this item to access the Culvert Memorial Dungeon.

name: Unidentified Fish
description: Bring these to Pipielle in Malangdo and he will exchange them for Malangdo Coins.

name: Will of Warrior
description: [SQI Ingredient] A collection of biological relics from various warriors. Used for combining biological materials in a testing lab

name: Blood Thirst
description: Reactionary forces causes the thirst for blood Used for combining biological materials in a testing lab

name: Ghost Chill
description: The darkness of Nifflheim is lumped into this. Used for combining biological materials in a testing lab

name: Thanks Invest Ticket
description: This item is account bound. A ticket that can be exchanged for various goods.

name: Cats Invest Certificate
description: This item is account bound. A certificate given by the cats paw merchants to invest in certain perks.

name: Eden Merit Badge
description: Account Bound. The Eden group recognizes the bearer of this badge as one who has done great deeds. These can be exchanged for various goods at Merry Badger of the Eden Group.

name: Tikbalang's Thick Spine
description: Tikbalang's thick and tough spine. Sell to a collection dealer. _

name: Lesser Agimat
description: Paper that protects a player from harm's way or casts special abilities. A faint energy can be felt. _

name: Jejellopy
description: Looks similar to a Large Jellopy but with a shinier crystal. _

name: Ancient Grudge
description: Paper that protects a player from harm's way or casts special abilities. _

name: Sharpened Bamboo
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Bamboo piece trimmed to be pointy. Looks like it was cut tilted from a thick bamboo.

name: Salt Bag
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Bag used to contain sea salt manufactured from the seashore. Said to scare off bad spirits.

name: Silver Cross
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Cross-shaped ornament made of silver. Used to scare off demons.

name: Spiritual Protection
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Portable spiritual protection made with holy energy from silver and exorcising energy from salt. Used to prevent bad spirits from approaching.

name: Cast-Iron Caldron
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Large caldron made from hard iron. Lets off a rich and full clunk sound when hit. Used to stun Bakonawa by making loud noises from it instead of cooking with it.

name: Purified Spirit Bone
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Wholly cleaned out bone was an Evil Spirit Bone purified by Mumbaki to get rid of all evilness. Guard dog Vantai especially likes it.

name: Offering Bouquet
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Flower bouquet made to comfort wandering or victimized souls. Offer flowers with a true heart and the souls may actually rest.

name: Evil Spirit Bone
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Animal bones with a hint of evil spirit. Won't be able to as dog treats at this state.

name: Silver Bracelet
description: Hellish silver bracelet. Looks more like a restraint.

name: Mysterious Flower
description: Mysteriously colorful flower. Looks like it was made from a rainbow.

name: Elegant Flower
description: Soft and gentle looking elegant flower.

name: Beautiful Flower
description: Ordinary flower that can be found anywhere.

name: Bakonawa Doll
description: Doll made to look like Bakonawa. Cuter than its original.

name: Bangungot Doll
description: Doll made to look like Bangungot. Suspicious of the creator's taste.

name: Buwaya Doll
description: Doll made to look like Buwaya. Popular among Port Malaya children.

name: Collected Sample
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Animal samples collected for a special purpose. Smells nasty.

name: Lost Belongings
description: Item cannot be traded with other characters. Belong to a missing Port Malaya villager.

name: Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit
description: Transparent item which imprisons Bakonawa's Spirit. Rumor says you can see Bakonawa when held up to moonlight.

name: Piece of Bangungot's Spirit
description: Transparent item which imprisons Bangungot's Spirit. Rumor says you can hear Bangungot's screeching screams when placed in a dark room.

name: Piece of Buwaya's Spirit
description: Transparent item which imprisons Buwaya's Spirit. Rumor says you can hear Buwaya's angry shrieks when touched with water.

name: Old Left Lapine
description: An old dusty jewelry that used to be shiny and beautiful.

name: Golden Leaf
description: Golden leaf fallen out from the home tree. Doesn't seem that important.

name: Avant Research Data
description: A research result by dark scientist Avant. Includes core research on Orb magic formula.

name: Star Shape Mushroom
description: Heavy mushroom that grows in Alfheim forest. Can be used for making medicine.

name: Firm Hair
description: Sapha Tribe's hair. It looks like a wood branch. But it is hair.

name: Younger Brother Letter
description: A letter from the brother with his love for the youngster.

name: Stained Research Book
description: Report about shape shifting. It has some kind of stain all over it.

name: Piece Of Laphine Wing
description: High class Lapine wing piece. It looks like it will take you to somewhere. But it doesn't work.

name: Mail Package
description: A box containing letters from Splendide to Eclage.

name: Leaf Made Wood
description: A big piece of bridge made with many weaved leaves together.

name: Birthday Candle
description: Birthday Candle, place on tall stands for 10 years, short stands for 1 year.

name: Fancy Fairy Wing
description: Big and fancy fairy wing. It looks pretty expensive.

name: Pile Of Acorn
description: A stack of small acorns. Not enough for anyone.

name: Eye Drops
description: A potion good for dried eyes. 5ml size.

name: Leaf Bookmark
description: A dusty bookmark left alone for a long time. It's so dry, you might break it easily.

name: Dustball
description: Dust, seems like this may be bad for our health.

name: Tiny Mouse Tail
description: Throw this near by Dominic. He will be frightened by the mouse.

name: Weeds
description: Wild weed that looks like it would grow anywhere. Let's plant it near the bookshelf.

name: Temporal Crystal
description: A rare crystal formed by a distortion of time. _

name: Coagulated Spell
description: A spell that has somehow become solid. _

name: Glast Decayed Nail
description: Surprisingly clean nails from the monsters of Glast Heim's past. _

name: Glast Horrendous Mouth
description: Teeth from the monsters of Glast Heim's past. _

name: Colorful Key
description: A colorful key that can be sold to merchants. _

name: Gold Coin Basket
description: A basket full of gold coins that can be sold to traders for profit. _

name: Colorful Brooch
description: A big and beautiful brooch. It looks like it could be worth a lot even though it is old and dusty. 'Happy 10th birthday Lowenburg. F. Earich' _

name: Siege Coin
description: This coin is made to commemorate every achievement of the guilds that fought for castles in the Midgard Continent. Collect this coin and exchange with special prizes. _

name: Rough Energy Crystal
description: An energy source that helps you increase the ability of certain items. Contains a small amount of energy.

name: Purified Energy Crystal
description: A refined energy source that helps you increase the ability of certain items. Contains an advanced concentrated form of energy.

name: High Energy Crystal
description: Account bound. A mighty energy source that helps you increase the ability of certain items The purest form of Energy Crystal.

name: Old Crown
description: An old, dented crown that is missing gemstones made of pure gold. It can be sold to a Merchant for zeny.

name: Broken Horn
description: A broken and bent singlehorn. It's not worth any reward it can fetch.

name: Old Ring
description: The tiny text inscribed on the inside of this ring is rubbed out and illegible.

name: Rusty Bracalet
description: A rusty and discolored bracelet. It has tiny initials inscribed on it.

name: Old Photo Album
description: An old, dirty photo album. Only a few pictures are left inside.

name: Old Pill
description: This pill covered with black fungi is carefully wrapped in a package along with the memo: ''Ingest when you have any breathing problems.''

name: Morocc Merit Certificate
description: A certificate given to people who help rebuilding Morocc. ________________________ Type: Valuable

name: Brick
description: A construction material used for restoration of Morocc. ________________________ Type: Quest

name: Long Rope
description: A construction material used for restoration of Morocc. ________________________ Type: Quest

name: Wood
description: A construction material used for restoration of Morocc. ________________________ Type: Quest

name: Hatchet
description: A simple axe that used by lumberjack. ________________________ Type: Quest

name: Contaminated Magic
description: Ill be contaminated substances emitted magical power. Plainly seems hard to manage. _

name: Mould Powder
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A handful of soft, powdery mould that is strangely silken to the touch. _

name: Ogre Tooth
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A tooth extracted from the mouth of a proud Orc Warrior. _

name: Anolian Skin
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A sticky piece of Anolian skin. _

name: Mud Lump
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A gooey, unpleasant lump of wet, dirty mud. _

name: Skull
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A skull taken from a corpse. _

name: Wing of Red Bat
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A wing from a red bat. _

name: Claw of Rat
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A toe nail from a huge, disease ridden rodent. _

name: Stiff Horn
description: A tough horn that might break, but will never bend. _

name: Glitter Shell
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A shell that sparkles with dazzling light. _

name: Tail of Steel Scorpion
description: A stinger ripped out of the body of a steel scorpion. _

name: Claw of Monkey
description: A monkey's claw that was used to peel many bananas. _

name: Tough Scalelike Stem
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A stem with a tough surface that feels like it's covered with thick, protective scales. _

name: Coral Reef
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] A small chunk of a reef formed by corals in clear, tropical waters. _

name: Old Portrait
description: An old, fragile portrait of a girl that you can't quite identify, although she seems very pretty. _

name: Memory Bookmark
description: An old leaf that can be used as a bookmark or to remind its owner of something quite important. _

name: Bent Spoon
description: A spoon that looks like it was used to dig some sort of underground tunnel. _

name: Executioner's Mitten
description: [SQI Ingredient] A glove worn when performing executions that has absorbed all sorts of memories that are related to death and obligation. _

name: Young Twig
description: [SQI Ingredient] A fresh, young twig that evokes feelings of purity and innocence. _

name: Loki's Whispers
description: [SQI Ingredient] A strange object in which the seductive whispers of Loki can be faintly heard. _

name: Mother's Nightmare
description: [SQI Ingredient] A mother's nightmares that have been given physical form. _

name: Foolishness of the Blind
description: A symbol of Hod, the blind god who was tricked into killing his brother Baldur, god of light. _

name: Old Hilt
description: An old hilt broken off a heavy sword. _

name: Blade of Darkness
description: [SQI Ingredient] A blade imbued with a suffocating aura that repels the light. _

name: Bloody Edge
description: [SQI Ingredient] A blade stained with blood that can't be cleansed. _

name: Lucifer's Lament
description: A gem that is said to be key to opening the path to the mysterious, ancient land of Geffenia. _

name: Key of the Clock Tower
description: An ornate key that can open what is locked in the Clock Tower. _

name: Key of the Underground
description: [SQI Bonus Ingredient] The key that can unlock the underground door in the Clock Tower. _

name: Invite for Duel
description: An invitation to an honorable duel. _

name: Admission for Duel
description: Admission to watch a duel between honorable combatants. _

name: Amatsu Travel Brochure
description: [Amatsu Travel Brochure] The people of Amatsu carry themselves with honor and tranquility. While visiting the city, make sure to see: 1. The beautiful Water Shrine. 2. The Lord of Amatsu, who is much more open than rulers of other lands and will talk to visitors and citizens alike. 3. The Legendary Tree, that holds many legends. It is said, that when you propose under its branches your marriage will be blessed. 4. The Coy Pond, located in the wonderful gardens, whose careful balance and flow reflect the keeper's state of mind. _

name: Gonryun Travel Brochure
description: [Gonryun Travel Brochure] Gonryun is a land in the clouds. Being so high in the air affords an unprecedented view of the world and gives a different mindset to those who allow themselves to think freely. While visiting the city, make sure to see: 1. The Statue of Gonryun's Greatest Philosopher, that stands proudly in the middle of town, ready to inspire great thoughts from all those that gaze upon him. 2. The Overlook of the World. There are particular spots that are exceptionally breathtaking, so please watch your step. 3. The small hill in Gonryun that is said to have been the Great Philosophers favorite meditation spot. See if any grand thoughts take you. 4. The Mini-town on ground beneath Gonryun that is a lesson against stagnant and small thinking. _

name: Louyang Travel Brochure
description: [Louyang Travel Brochure] Louyang is a spiritual country, where the warrior spirit and clear thinking are highly prized. While visiting the city, make sure to see: 1. Such wondrous sites such as the Statue of the Man and the Tiger, that may inspire you to do your best. 2. The Hospital, where the Louyang healers practice their art. There, your body will be cured by a system of body manipulations and diet. 3. The beautiful Palace that is protected by the Great Wall of Louyang. It is truly a sight to behold for every visitor. 4. The Tower where people practice there lungs by shouting from it. Something to relax after a hard day of martial arts and spirit training. _

name: Ayothaya Travel Brochure
description: [Ayothaya Travel Brochure] Transcend your limitations, and find life's perfect philosophy is Ayothaya's Heritage. While visiting the city, make sure to see: 1. The Reclining Philosopher Statues, that symbolise Ayothaya's great Philosophers that all Ayothayans seek to emulate. 2. The Shrine in Ayothaya and meditate upon your life's journey. Keep the balance of your mind and body. 3. The Tom Yum Goong Restaurant where the famous and truly delicious soup will refuel your body. Don't leave Ayothaya without sampling the dishes there. _

itemScript: if(react_comm_cd < gettimetick(2) && !callfunc("F_Map_VS") && #sqi_v3_quest >= 24) { pcblockmove getcharid(3),1; specialeffect2 1056; specialeffect2 1046; sleep2 2000; specialeffect2 1072; sleep2 300; pcblockmove getcharid(3),0; if (HP) { react_comm_cd = gettimetick(2)+600; warp "vanaheim",204,129; } }

name: Vanir's Ascension
description: A divine artifact given to you by Kvasir. The Vanir's incantation allows you to embed your Super Quest Item with unique abilities. _
itemScript: if ( getmapflag(strcharinfo(3),MF_TOWN) ) { callfunc("F_SQI_Vanir_Ascension"); } else { unittalk getcharid(3),"You can't use this item unless you are at town.",bc_self; }

name: Applause Sandals
description: Beautiful mysterious shoes decorated with blue roses. [PvP/BG/WoE Only] MDEF + 10 [Every 2 Refine Levels] 1% less Aftercast Delay. [+Amon Ra Card] All Stats except DEX + 1.

name: Temporal STR Boots
description: These boots are obviously old but they show no signs of wear and tear. MaxHP + 300 MaxSP + 30 [Base STR >= 95] HIT + 10 [Every Refine Level +4~10] [Whitesmith] Total ATK + 1% [Other Classes] Short Range ATK + 1%
itemScript: .@i = getrefine(); bonus bMaxHP,300; bonus bMaxSP,30; if ( .@i >= 4 ) { if ( Class == Job_Whitesmith ) { bonus bAtkRate,.@i - 3; } else { bonus bShortAtkRate,.@i - 3; } } if ( readparam(bStr) >= 95 ) bonus bHit,10;

description: These boots are obviously old but they show no signs of wear and tear. MaxHP + 500 MaxSP + 30 Natural HP Recovery + 10% [Every Refine Level] MaxHP + 100 [Base VIT >= 95] DEF + 3 Natural HP Recovery + 20%

name: Temporal DEX Boots

itemScript: bonus bMaxHP,300; bonus bMaxSP,30; bonus bLongAtkRate,2; bonus bHit,2*getrefine(); if ( readparam(bDex) >= 95 ) bonus bDelayrate,-5;

name: Temporal LUK Boots
description: These boots are obviously old but they show no signs of wear and tear. MaxHP + 300 MaxSP + 30 [Every Refine Level +4~10] CRIT + 1 [Every Refine Level +5~10] Crafting/Brewing Success + 0.5% [Every 19 Base LUK] Critical ATK/Skills + 3%
